serverInfo.name: largen
serverInfo.title: largen — a property algebra for CSS

description: Tools for authoring and debugging largen components: the contract, the reference component sources, a linter, a cascade resolver, and a browser probe. Every tool that reasons about components takes your own component manifest, because largen expects you to write your own and cannot know them.

tools.name: list_components
tools.title: List the components a spec may name

tools.name: get_component_source
tools.title: Get the CSS of a reference component

tools.name: lookup_property
tools.title: Ask whether a CSS property is driven by a slot

tools.name: check_layer_order
tools.title: Resolve cascade layer order across stylesheets

tools.name: get_build
tools.title: Get the identity and checksums of the served stylesheets

tools.name: render_spec
tools.title: Render a spec to HTML and a preview URL

tools.name: emit_probe
tools.title: Emit a browser harness you run against your own build

tools.name: resolve_cascade
tools.title: Resolve which declaration wins for one property on one element

tools.name: explain_slot
tools.title: Explain whether the paint rule applies a slot, or it reverts
